context: Friends plan to meet for a brand sale
purpose: Plan a shopping trip; teach 集合/ブランド/キャンペーン/勝手/スタイル/妙/だり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: What time shall we meet today?
lines.style: easygoing friend coordinating plans, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前に十時でどう？ あのブランドのセール見たい。
lines.en: Ten at the station? I want to see that brand’s sale.
lines.style: eager friend keen on the shopping

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね、今キャンペーン中だもんね。
lines.en: Nice, there’s a promotion on right now.
lines.style: enthusiastic friend confirming the deal, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 勝手に決めちゃ悪いけど、先に行ってもいい？
lines.en: Bad to decide on my own, but can I go ahead?
lines.style: slightly apologetic friend asking politely, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: どうぞどうぞ。あのお店、スタイルがいい服多いよね。
lines.en: Go ahead. That shop has lots of flattering styles.
lines.style: easygoing friend praising the store, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、でもたまに妙なデザインもあるよね。
lines.en: Yeah, but sometimes there are odd designs.
lines.style: candid friend adding a wry caveat

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 悩んだり相談したりして選ぼう。
lines.en: Let’s pick by mulling and consulting.
lines.style: easygoing friend suggesting a relaxed approach
